question: What commands does this mantra give against the named person?
premises: The verse salutes Mahābala and related names.
It names a person with amukasya.
It commands binding, stalling, shaking, and striking down.
inference: The mantra commands binding arm-strength and sight, stalling limbs, shaking, and striking the named person to earth.
plain_english: Om, salutation to Mahābala, Parākrama, Śastra-vidyā, Viśārada, Śārada: bind the arm-strength of so-and-so, bind; stall sight, stall; shake limbs, shake; strike down, strike down to earth, hūṃ.
